title: Latent daily review · Oct 10
tldr: No new fixes from me today. Nothing new was a clear, unfixed code bug, so I launched no Cloud Agents and made no Linear issue.

Big wave of testers asking to stay: 44 more people chose “Stay as a Beta Tester” since yesterday's dig (29 left an email, 15 only a phone number). The 4 from yesterday (shlokp, charanistired, philan_jin, ankithrao30) and tridha still have no reply from you.

You merged #464 (people who answer the age check under 13 are now held, not deleted) and #465 (1.0.6, build 38, for TestFlight). Malcolm merged #466 to #468 (week graph scale, and the Locked in with / shared posts work for TRY-312). Malcolm's #463 is still open.

One new in-app idea from @s4yy: let people change the yellow default color, and show hours on the monthly view. Discord: nothing new. Survey unchanged (39/25/2 of 66). Sentry: 3 new one-person freezes (APPLE-IOS-6D to 6F). PostHog: group stats failures are down a bit (98 from 36 people in 24h).

replyDrafts.subject: Re: TestFlight beta feedback for Latent
replyDrafts.theirMessage:
Heyy
I don’t know my when i entered my age on latent (15 year old) it deleted my acc saying its for 13 and above. I had a 3 week long streak as well. Please help me, i don’t want to lose everything please

I am a high schooler and this really means a lot to me. Please i have trust in you that you’ll brung my account back. Please.
replyDrafts.body:
Hey Tridha, I'm so sorry this happened, that's a really rough way to lose a 3 week streak 😭 The age check removed accounts when the birthday came out under 13, so the wheel probably landed on the wrong year, and we've just changed it so that can't wipe an account anymore. [CHECK: whether you can or want to restore her account or streak; it was hard-deleted, so only promise what you can do] You're welcome to sign up again with your real birthday, and I'm here if anything else goes wrong!

Eddie
replyDrafts.note: Carried from Oct 9, still unanswered. #464 (merged Oct 9, in TestFlight 1.0.6 build 38) holds instead of deletes from now on, but it doesn't bring back her deleted account.
